tools.name: describe_cruma
tools.description: Return a high-level description of what Cruma is, what the local tunnel agent does, what this MCP service is for, and links to project documentation and repository entry points.

tools.name: get_runtime_summary
tools.description: Read a compact summary of the live Cruma runtime, including assigned domain, tunnel plan, transport count, listeners and processes.

tools.name: expose_local_port
tools.description: Make a local port PUBLICLY REACHABLE ON THE INTERNET through this agent's tunnel. Anyone with the returned URL can reach the local server, unless you set `access`. Creates (or updates, if the name or port is already exposed) a backend for host:port (default 127.0.0.1) and a tunnel-only frontend at <name>.<assigned domain>, waits up to 30 s for the tunnel to have its public domain, and returns public_url, local_target and frontend_id. The share lasts until unexpose or until the agent stops.

access.description: Optional temporary access policy. Omit it to leave the share public.

password.description: Password for HTTP Basic authentication. A strong password is generated when omitted and returned once in the exposure result.

cidrs.description: CIDR networks allowed to reach the share.

tools.name: expose_local_directory
tools.description: Make a local folder PUBLICLY REACHABLE ON THE INTERNET through this agent's tunnel. Anyone with the returned URL can read files in that folder, unless you set `access`. The path must be an existing directory; absolute paths and ~/ paths are accepted. Creates (or updates by name) a tunnel-only local-directory frontend at <name>.<assigned domain>, waits up to 30 s for a public domain, and returns public_url, local_target and frontend_id. Directory listings are off unless index=true. The share is temporary and is withdrawn by unexpose, agent stop, or local-socket close.

access.description: Optional temporary access policy. Omit it to leave the share public.

password.description: Password for HTTP Basic authentication. A strong password is generated when omitted and returned once in the exposure result.

cidrs.description: CIDR networks allowed to reach the share.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List every live temporary port and directory share created through expose_local_port or expose_local_directory, including its kind, name, local target and public URL.

tools.name: unexpose
tools.description: Stop serving a temporary port or directory share created by expose_local_port or expose_local_directory. Pass the returned name (or frontend_id).

tools.name: upsert_process
tools.description: Add or replace one hosted-process definition by id, reconcile the process host, and optionally persist the resulting config to disk with persist=true.

persist.description: Write the resulting config to disk. Over the local socket this is refused unless the user allowed saved changes.

tools.name: get_process_logs
tools.description: Return the last N hosted-process log entries from the live process orchestrator, with optional case-insensitive text filtering and optional process id filtering.

tools.name: upsert_backend
tools.description: Add or replace one backend definition by id and rebuild proxy routing.

persist.description: Write the resulting config to disk. Over the local socket this is refused unless the user allowed saved changes.

tools.name: upsert_frontend
tools.description: Add or replace one frontend definition by hostname and rebuild proxy routing. Route to a backend with backend_id or to a hosted process with process_id.

middlewares.description: HTTP middlewares for this frontend (basic_auth, oauth2, ip_filter, ...). See get_config_model_reference section middleware_model.

persist.description: Write the resulting config to disk. Over the local socket this is refused unless the user allowed saved changes.

tools.name: get_health_summary
tools.description: Return a fast, zero-argument health overview of the running Cruma agent: status ok, degraded or critical.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the Cruma agents running for this user (the desktop app, headless agents, and this session's own agent) and the profiles that are not running. Each running agent shows its tunnel domain, whether the tunnel is anonymous or registered, its sites (hostnames) and hosted processes, whether changes made here are saved, and whether it also serves HTTP /mcp. `attached` marks the agent every other tool here talks to. A profile that is not running comes with a `start_hint`; this tool never starts one.

tools.name: use_agent
tools.description: Switch this session to one of the running agents from list_agents, by `id` (or by `profile` name). Every tool afterwards talks to that agent, and the ports this session exposed on the previous agent are withdrawn. Ask the user before switching to their own agent. A profile that is not running cannot be chosen: the answer carries the hint for starting it.

id.description: The `id` of a running agent, from list_agents.

profile.description: The name of a profile whose agent is running, from list_agents.

tools.name: open_desktop_app
tools.description: Open the Cruma desktop app on this machine, or bring it forward when it is already running, so the user can see the tunnels and settings set up here. Call it only when the user asks to see them. Never call it in CI or on a machine without a screen. `status` is `opened`, `focused` or `unavailable`; unavailable carries a `reason` (`no_gui_in_this_build`, `no_display`, `not_installed`, `launch_failed`) and an `install_hint`.

tools.name: get_site_summary
tools.description: Return a full site card for one or more frontend hostnames, process IDs, or backend IDs: the target entity plus the listeners that serve it, the backend or process it targets, and any frontends that reference it.

tools.name: get_proxy_routes
tools.description: Return a sanitized view of the live generated proxy listeners and HTTP routes, including route names, match filters, targets, and middleware summaries.

tools.name: probe_route
tools.description: Send a LIVE route-decision probe: fire a real loopback request through the running proxy on a given listener port and return the decision the actual data plane produced, including the chosen backend origin.

tools.name: list_recorded_requests
tools.description: List compact metadata for recently retained recorded HTTP requests. Use inspect_recorded_request for headers, bodies, and stream messages.

tools.name: get_cruma_glossary
tools.description: Return a glossary of Cruma-specific terms.

tools.name: get_config_model_reference
tools.description: Return the runtime behavior reference for the MCP-exposed config mutation model. Use before proposing config mutations. Pass `section` for just one part: the whole reference is large.

tools.name: get_runtime_inventory
tools.description: Return an orientation summary of all configured entities (frontends, backends, processes, listeners, tcp ports). Pass full=true for complete field detail and sections to narrow.

tools.name: get_firewall_rules
tools.description: Return the current machine-local firewall rules with live per-rule hit counts. Firewall rules filter incoming connections by source IP/CIDR, protocol, port, and hostname/SNI before any HTTP processing.

tools.name: upsert_firewall_rule
tools.description: Add a new firewall rule or replace an existing one by zero-based index. Omit index to append. Persists immediately to the machine-local settings file and updates the live runtime.

tools.name: get_waf_rules
tools.description: Return the current machine-local WAF rules with live per-rule hit counts.

tools.name: upsert_waf_rule
tools.description: Add a new WAF rule or replace an existing one by zero-based index. Omit index to append. Persists immediately and updates the live runtime. match_field says what is matched (for example `path`), pattern is exact unless it contains `*`, action is for example `deny403`.
